lastCompletedStory.title: Shared runnable behavioral gate: drive real cam in tmux, capture, assert

nextStoryContext: US-002 delivered runBehavioralGate in src/supervisor/behavioral-gate.ts. The function accepts an OracleDirective and RunBehavioralGateOpts (injectable spawnFn + socketName + cwd + timeoutMs). It returns BehavioralGateResult { passed, capturedPane, detail }. Default socket is BEHAVIORAL_GATE_SOCKET ('cam-behavioral-gate'), never bare 'cam'. Non-runnable oracle kinds (reviewer-judgment, no-oracle, tmux-pty) return passed:false immediately. named-command and file-assert run in a private tmux session: creates session with '-L socketName', sends command + exit-code marker ('CAMGATE_N') via send-keys, polls capture-pane in 300ms ticks until marker found or timeout, kills session in finally. Helpers extracted to stay under biome complexity limit 15: resolveNonRunnableResult (handles 3 early-return cases) and pollForExitCode (the while-loop poll). Integration test at test/integration/behavioral-gate.test.ts: uses TEST_SOCK='cam-it-gate', kill-server in beforeEach/afterEach, test.skipIf(!tmuxAvailable) for real-tmux cases. US-003 can import runBehavioralGate and BEHAVIORAL_GATE_SOCKET from src/supervisor/behavioral-gate.ts.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Gate runner uses only node:child_process (stdlib spawnSync) and Bun built-ins (Bun.sleepSync). No external library exercised.
